question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Proactive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Proactive **means taking action before a situation becomes a problem. (किसी स्थिति के समस्या बनने से पहले कार्रवाई करना)
 
• Grammatically, it is an adjective that describes a person or behaviour.
 
 
• **Example**: *The company's proactive approach to customer service helped them retain loyal customers.*
 
 

Therefore, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Productive **means being able to produce or achieve a lot. (बहुत कुछ पैदा करने या हासिल करने में सक्षम होना)
 
• **Bioactive **refers to a substance that has an effect on living tissue. (एक पदार्थ जो जीवित ऊतकों पर प्रभाव डालता है)
 
• **Inactive **means not active or not functioning. (सक्रिय नहीं है या कार्य नहीं कर रहा है)
